US restricts China's access to advanced semiconductor chips

The United States has implemented measures to restrict China's remote access to advanced semiconductor (SI) chips. These arrangements are in place to continue access to advanced US chips amid cutbacks. The move aims to limit China's ability to obtain and utilize cutting-edge chip technology.
